A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete 12-page Vivid-VR paper, including Appendix A. Text comparison and rendered-page inspection establish identical research content; differences are confined to the arXiv version/date stamp and its version link.

before.justification: v3 reports original video-restoration benchmark results in Table 1 and ablation results in Tables 2–4, including appendix experiments.

after.justification: v4 retains the original benchmark results in Table 1, ablations in Tables 2–4, and qualitative restoration results.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Appendix A retain the same CogVideoX1.5-5B backbone, concept distillation, control feature projector, dual-branch connector, and restoration-guided sampling procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same training collection and evaluate on SPMCS, UDM10, YouHQ40, VideoLQ, UGC50, and AIGC50. No dataset, task, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains Real-ESRGAN, SUPIR, MGLD, UAV, STAR, DOVE, SeedVR-7B, and SeedVR2-7B. Comparator membership also remains unchanged in the qualitative comparisons and ablations.

E3.justification: Sections 4.1–4.2 retain identical preprocessing, training budgets, inference settings, and evaluation metrics, including 1024×1024 processing and 50 denoising steps. The appendix experiment settings also match.

E4.justification: Section 5 retains the projector, connector, concept-distillation, and captioner ablations. Appendix A retains the guidance trade-off, generated-training-data quantity, and ControlNet block-count analyses without revision.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or formal significance tests. Statistical reporting is unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–4 and qualitative findings match. For example, Vivid-VR's UGC50 NIQE and MUSIQ remain 4.361 and 67.61, respectively.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(3), their definitions, and the accompanying mathematical descriptions are identical. Neither version adds or removes formal assumptions, theoretical results, or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contribution list, and conclusion retain identical claims about concept distillation, the control architecture, restoration quality, and temporal consistency.

C2.justification: The distribution-drift explanation, interpretation of full-reference metrics, lengthy-inference limitation, and appendix discussions of fidelity versus quality and generated-data limitations are unchanged.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware, training time, and data-processing descriptions are identical. The code and project-page access information also remains unchanged.

R1.justification: Both versions contain the same 46 references and identical related-work discussion and positioning relative to prior restoration and diffusion methods.

P1.justification: The first-page margin stamp changes from arXiv v3 dated 26 September 2025 to v4 dated 27 June 2026. The paper's prose, terminology, headings, and section structure are otherwise identical.

P2.justification: All eight figures, four tables, captions, and their placement are unchanged. Rendered pages match throughout, apart from the version/date text in the first-page margin.

improvement.justification: The scientific text, equations, results, figures, and appendix analyses are identical. Updating the arXiv version/date stamp and its version link produces no meaningful change in the paper's evidence, clarity, reproducibility, or overall quality.
